QuestInfo.name: The Brothers' Stack of Rice 3
QuestInfo.1: Chil Sung was puzzled that his stack didn't seem to decrease, and asked me if I could place another #t4031229# on his brother's stack.
QuestInfo.2: I received a #t4031229# from Chil Sung, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Nam's house.

0.0: Did you make sure my brother did not find out about this? Something's weird, though. It seems like my stack of rice didn't shrink one bit. Don't you think so, too? Well, that's why... can you go back to Chil Nam's house once more?

yes.0: I urge you, please make sure my brother doesn't know about this.

no.0: I'm sorry. I should have known that I was pushing it by asking you to do this twice...

1.0: I see a stack of rice stacked at the garden of Chil Nam's house. Secretly, I brought out a sack of rice and laid it unnoticeably on top of the stack.

item.0: This is Chil Nam's stack of rice.

lost.0: I think you forgot to take #t4031229#.
